title: skills: three rules that teach a stored computed field (a non-formula field carrying an `expression`) do not say a cross-record or volatile input is warned at authoring (PR #32701's Skills-docs follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz

Filing gate: ① published skill text that teaches a shape the platform now warns on, owed by an in-flight PR (PR #32701's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line; the seat files the card and rewrites that line to this number). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/**`, shipped with `npx skills add`).
Dedupe: `is:issue stored computed field skills cross-record volatile` → 3 hits (#32529, #32614, a seat post), none on the skills text.
reach: named producer — the published skills an authoring agent loads. On `origin/main`: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (~:325-333, the line-item "Computed column" bullet), `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (~:131, the `formula` row: "both need a stored field of its return type with the same `expression`"), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (~:100-103, the total-over-a-formula bullet). Each tells an agent to move a formula's `expression` onto a stored field; none says the two rules PR #32701 adds: an input read from another record (`record.<lookup>.<field>`) is warned at authoring (`stored-expression-cross-record-input`, warning, #32529; seat call 6821360087), and one that changes without a write (the clock, the acting user, a permission check) is warned (`stored-expression-volatile-input`, #32554). An agent following the skill as written on a formula like `record.customer.discount * record.amount` writes a field that now draws an authoring warning and goes stale on the next change of the related record.

## Business reason

The skills are the agent's instructions; the lint is what refuses. After #32443 (ruled B) the skills route every "total a computed value" case to a stored computed field, so the shapes they leave unqualified are exactly the ones the new rules catch. Saying it in the skill turns a warning-then-retry loop into a first-time correct field.

## Ask

- In each of the three places, one sentence: a stored computed field reads only its own row's fields; a value from a related record stays a `formula` (read time, not totallable) or is a snapshot a flow on the related record writes (`os migrate stored-expressions --changed` repairs drift); an input that changes without a write (`now()`, `today()`, the acting user, `can()`) is fixed at the write and warned.
- Use the rule ids and the remedy wording PR #32701 lands (read them on `main` after it merges). Lands after PR #32701.

Blocked-by: #32529
